messages.subject: January 2023 Introductory distance sampling workshop, registration closes 30 Nov
parts:
A reminder that registration for the remaining handful of places in the 09-20 January training workshop closes in just under two weeks (30 November). Anyone in the U.S. planning to register, I encourage you do so prior to your Thanksgiving holiday 🦃.

Details about the workshop and the registration process can be found at

http://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-jan-2023.html

Any questions, please send them to me.

Eric Rexstad

Centre for Research into Ecological and Environmental Modelling

University of St Andrews
